label: Caciottina Montanara
aka: Formaggio al burro di San Candido

about.text: A small butter-style table cheese of about 600 g, with a thin edible straw-yellow rind, from the Upper Val Pusteria, especially San Candido. It is made from pasteurised cow's milk and aged about three weeks in cool rooms.
